title: A Survey on Cloud-Edge-Terminal Collaborative Intelligence in AIoT Networks
abstract: arXiv:2508.18803v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The proliferation of Internet of things (IoT) devices in smart cities, transportation, healthcare, and industrial applications, coupled with the explosive growth of AI-driven services, has increased demands for efficient distributed computing architectures and networks, driving cloud-edge-terminal collaborative intelligence (CETCI) as a fundamental paradigm within the artificial intelligence of things (AIoT) community. translated_title: 智能物联网网络中云-边-端协同智能综述
translated_abstract: 物联网设备在智慧城市、交通、医疗和工业应用中的普及，加上人工智能驱动服务的爆炸式增长，增加了对高效分布式计算架构和网络的需求，推动云-边-端协同智能成为人工智能物联网社区中的一种基础范式。随着深度学习、大语言模型和边缘计算的发展，CETCI在新兴AIoT应用中取得了显著进展，超越了孤立的层次优化，迈向可部署的人工智能物联网协同智能系统，成为人工智能、分布式计算和通信领域的实际研究焦点。本综述描述了CETCI范式的基础架构、使能技术和应用场景，为CISAIOT初学者提供了教程式的回顾。
tldr: 本综述系统梳理了智能物联网网络中云-边-端协同智能的基础架构、使能技术与应用场景，展示其从孤立层次优化向可部署协同智能系统的演进，为初学者提供教程式指导。
en_tdlr: This survey systematically reviews the foundational architectures, enabling technologies, and application scenarios of cloud-edge-terminal collaborative intelligence in AIoT networks, tracing its evolution from isolated layer optimization to deployable collaborative intelligence systems as a tutorial-style guide for beginners.
